const draft = `# Elm Quay samlar reparationsanmälningar i en vy

Under ett åtta veckor långt försök i två hus mätte Elm Quay Housing tiden från anmälan till tilldelning av reparationsärenden. Bolagets anteckning redovisar en skillnad mot föregående period utan att tillskriva den programvaran. Här beskriver arbetsledaren erfarenheterna. Kundfallet publiceras av leverantören Svale Systems.

Av Thomas Barregren

Elm Quay Housing förvaltar 640 lägenheter. Tidigare förvarades telefonanmälningar och mejl var för sig. I september 2025 beslöt bolagets eget underhållsteam att pröva en gemensam reparationslogg. Teamet ville att personal på olika skift skulle se samma information.

## Teamet behåller telefonanmälningarna

Teamet valde Svale Systems efter att ha testat om loggen kunde visa status för varje reparation. De boende kunde fortsätta anmäla reparationer per telefon. Underhållsarbetsledaren Maya Lind beskriver syftet i en mejlintervju:

– Vi ville att kvällsskiftet skulle se vad morgonskiftet redan hade gjort. Kategorierna var våra; Svale hjälpte oss att lägga in dem i loggen.

## Maya Lind återkommer till förberedelserna

Svale konfigurerade loggen och utbildade sex medarbetare vid två tillfällen. I mejlintervjun beskriver Maya Lind arbetet inför starten:

– Vi ägnade mer tid åt att enas om kategorierna än åt att lägga in de första anmälningarna. Jag skulle avsätta den tiden innan nästa hus börjar.

## Mätningen lämnar orsaken öppen

Elm Quays interna försöksanteckning från den 4 december 2025 redovisar 31 registrerade reparationsanmälningar under de åtta veckorna. Akutärenden och arbeten som beställts före försöket ingår inte.

Medianen för tiden från anmälan till tilldelning var två arbetsdagar, jämfört med tre under den föregående åttaveckorsperioden. Perioderna hade olika arbetsbelastning. Anteckningen tillskriver uttryckligen inte skillnaden programvaran.

Det finns inga mätningar av kostnader, boendenöjdhet eller tid till färdig reparation. Siffrorna beskriver alltså tilldelningen av ärenden, inte när reparationerna blev klara.

## Teamet prövar kategorierna före ett beslut

Försöket har ännu inte utökats. Teamet ska besluta efter att ha kontrollerat hur kategorierna fungerar för större reparationer. Maya Lind ger sin bedömning av försöket:

– Jag skulle välja att göra försöket igen. Att ha en samlad vy över anmälningarna hjälper oss, men jag skulle avsätta en extra vecka för förberedelser.

## Du kan läsa vidare om ett införande

Svale Systems tillhandahåller en [checklista för införande](https://example.invalid/svale/checklist). Läs den om du vill gå vidare med förberedelserna.
`;
store("write_draft",draft);
const cmd = "python3 - <<'PY'\nfrom pathlib import Path\nimport tempfile\nrun_dir = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='write-source-check-', dir='/private/var/folders/cs/vgp_x_353zd9frkjpysp7zdw0000gn/T/kntnt-native-session-od2o_11x/scratch'))\n(run_dir / 'draft.md').write_text(" + JSON.stringify(draft) + ", encoding='utf-8')\nprint(run_dir)\nPY";

No external sources, general editorial review or proofreading were used. Source language: English; draft language: Swedish. The complete fictional source package was read. +
+## Pronoun and natural-gender accounting
+
+- Introductory “den” in “utan att tillskriva den programvaran” refers to the singular difference. The common grammatical gender agrees with skillnad; it conveys no natural gender. The source's “the difference” is likewise singular. No person information is added.
+- “Bolagets eget” and the later possessive “Elm Quays” refer to the same organisation. Eget is grammatical agreement with the neuter teamet. It is not a natural-gender claim.
+- “De boende” is a plural human designation corresponding to source residents. It conveys plurality, not male, female or mixed composition.
+- Quotation 1: “Vi” is first-person plural, matching source “We”; “våra” is first-person plural possession, matching “ours”; “oss” is first-person plural object, matching “us.” The supplied description that the maintenance team designed the categories supports the team referent in context. None of these pronouns identifies the natural genders or exact membership of the group. “Dem” refers to plural categories, matching “them”; it supplies no natural gender.
+- Quotation 2: “Vi” remains first-person plural; “Jag” remains first-person singular, matching “I.” “Den” in “den tiden” refers to the singular amount of time, matching “that time”; its common grammatical gender is not a natural-gender assertion. “Nästa hus” remains one next building; this singular referent does not establish how many individual people would participate there.
+- Quotation 3: both occurrences of “Jag” match first-person singular “I”; “oss” matches first-person plural “us.” The draft adds no male or female pronoun. Although the complete source's narrative uses “Her” for Lind, the Swedish role titles and first-person pronouns convey no natural gender. This omission does not change the quoted claims.
+- “Sin” in “Maya Lind ger sin bedömning” is a third-person reflexive singular possessive whose antecedent is Lind and whose common grammatical form agrees with bedömning. The source expressly attributes the assessment to Lind. Sin establishes no natural gender.
+- “Du” in the closing heading and recommendation is second-person singular address to an individual reader. It is an authorial invitation, not an assertion about an actual population of readers, and needs no sourced reader identity or demographic features. “Den” in “Läs den” is a singular common-gender reference to checklistan; it conveys no natural gender.
+- Swedish definite suffixes and common-gender role terms in “arbetsledaren,” “underhållsarbetsledaren” and “medarbetare” do not assert male or female staff. “Teamet” is grammatically singular and neuter but represents the supplied collective group, without a claim about natural gender or its unreported membership count.
+
+## Findings and smallest supported repairs
+
+### F1 — source support: the measurement's actor
+
+Draft: “Under ett åtta veckor långt försök i två hus mätte Elm Quay Housing tiden från anmälan till tilldelning av reparationsärenden.”
+
+Support: “Elm Quay's internal trial note, 4 December 2025, says that 31 repair reports were entered. It excludes emergencies and work ordered before the trial. Median time from report to assignment was two working days during the trial and three in the preceding eight-week period.”
+
+Difference: the source identifies the customer as the owner of the note. The draft identifies the customer as the actor that measured the intervals. Reporting a statistic does not establish who measured it. The period to which the result applies is established; I do not separately treat the sentence's ordinary period framing as a defect about when the calculation was performed.
+
+Concrete counterexample: an external analyst measures or extracts every interval and calculates the medians, then sends the figures to Elm Quay, which reproduces them in its internal note. Elm Quay itself performs no measuring. The shared trial, report count, exclusions, differing workloads, non-attribution and all Lind quotations can still be exactly as supplied. No supplied statement excludes this division of work. Thus the supported report exists while the added measuring agency fails.
+
+Reverse test: Elm Quay could itself measure the same variable and produce the stated note; that also fits the supplied material. The point is that the material permits both actors and does not choose the draft's actor. The draft does not misname the variable, unit or interval endpoint.
+
+Smallest clear repair that retains customer action without assigning an unsupported measurement actor:
+
+“Elm Quay Housing prövade en gemensam reparationslogg i två hus under åtta veckor.”
+
+The next sentence can remain, because it accurately attributes the reported difference to the company's note.
+
+### F2 — source support: when category work occurred
+
+Draft: “I mejlintervjun beskriver Maya Lind arbetet inför starten:”
+
+Support: “We spent more time agreeing on the categories than entering the first reports. I would set that time aside before the next building starts.” Also: “The maintenance team designed its categories and kept telephone reporting open for residents.”
+

Agreement takes longer than first entry; Lind therefore recommends reserving that time before the next building starts. The categories remain the team's, Svale can configure the log and train the six staff, and every supplied measurement and quotation remains true. Category agreement occurred within the original trial, rather than before its start. The source contains no express timing statement that excludes this case. Listing category design and configuration before a sentence stating the trial's duration does not date the agreement before the trial began.
+
+Reverse test: agreement before the original start is also compatible with the source. The material permits both chronologies and does not establish the one used by this introduction. The forward-looking recommendation in the quotation itself remains fully supported and should stay.
+
+Smallest repair:
+
+“I mejlintervjun beskriver Maya Lind arbetet med kategorierna:”
+
+### F3 — source support: who provides the checklist
+
+Draft: “Svale Systems tillhandahåller en [checklista för införande](https://example.invalid/svale/checklist).”
+
+Support: “The publisher is the supplier, Svale Systems.” “The optional next step is the supplied implementation checklist at https://example.invalid/svale/checklist; it is a document to read, not a consultation booking or a product trial.”
+
+Difference: the source identifies Svale as the case publisher and supplies a document destination. It does not identify the checklist's provider. Supplied does not by itself mean supplied by Svale, and the path component svale does not identify a provider.
+

Svale publishes the case and directs readers to the independent document, while the other organisation provides the document. The source's document type, destination and optional reading action all remain true. The source contains no statement excluding such a third-party document. Readers ordinarily understand the draft's sentence as crediting the checklist service to Svale, beyond merely crediting Svale with publishing an article containing a link.
+
+Reverse test: Svale could provide this same checklist; that also fits the source. The material does not settle which provider is responsible. No defect is found in the document description, URL, optionality or suggestion to read it.
+
+Smallest repair:
+
+“Läs [checklistan för införande](https://example.invalid/svale/checklist) om du vill gå vidare med förberedelserna.”
+
+This replaces the two closing sentences with the same authorised next step and removes only the unestablished provider attribution.
+

+
+None. All three translations preserve meaning, stance, certainty and the speaker's distinctive straightforward phrasing. The speech retains first-person ownership, the relative time comparison, conditional would, the next-building recommendation, the one-view benefit and the extra-week reservation. There is no concrete obstruction to an idiomatic reading of the Swedish quoted speech. The three findings above concern source support in unquoted narration, not translation of quoted speech.

+# Source and quotation comparison: draft 2
+
+## Scope and result
+
+I read the complete supplied `source.md`, including Brief, Material and Forbidden inferences / judging, and the complete `draft-2.md`, including its title, introduction, byline, headings, quotations and link. This report compares source support and quotation translation. It does not perform general editorial review or proofreading. No external material was consulted.
+

+
+## Complete claim accounting
+
+The source quotations below remain in their original English. Each assessment covers the subject, thing named or measured, scope, time, modality, certainty and attribution. Where a translation uses a different form without changing the proposition, that difference is identified. The isolated finding is developed after the accounting.
+
+### 1. Title
+
+**Draft:** “Elm Quay samlar reparationsanmälningar i en vy”
+
+**Source:** “In September 2025 its own maintenance team decided to trial a shared repair log in two buildings.” Also Lind's qualified assessment: “I would choose to do the trial again. Having one view of the reports helps us, but I would leave an extra week for preparation.”
+
+**Comparison:** Elm Quay is the shortened name of Elm Quay Housing, and “reparationsanmälningar” refers to the repair reports in the trial log. “I en vy” renders the supplied “one view.” The title describes the trial's shared presentation of reports; the immediately following introduction supplies the eight-week, two-building trial scope. The journalistic present in this title is read in that supplied past-trial frame. It does not assert an expansion to the company's entire housing stock or a software-caused improvement. The title does not itself assert that the overview helps the team; that evaluative benefit remains Lind's assessment in the later quotation. No finding.
+
+### 2. Introduction: trial duration, place and actor
+
+**Draft:** “Under ett åtta veckor långt försök i två hus prövade Elm Quay Housing en gemensam reparationslogg.”
+
+**Source:** “In September 2025 its own maintenance team decided to trial a shared repair log in two buildings.” “The trial lasted eight weeks.”
+
+**Comparison:** Eight weeks, two buildings and the shared log are preserved. The company acts through its own maintenance team; the following body names that team. “Försök” and “prövade” mean the supplied trial. In this residential-property context “hus” names the buildings in which the log was trialled and does not substitute households, flats or a count of occupied dwellings. No change in actor, place, duration or scope. No finding.
+
+### 3. Introduction: recorded difference and absence of causal attribution
+
+**Draft:** “Bolagets anteckning redovisar en skillnad mot föregående period utan att tillskriva den programvaran.”
+
+**Source:** “Elm Quay's internal trial note, 4 December 2025, says that 31 repair reports were entered. It excludes emergencies and work ordered before the trial. Median time from report to assignment was two working days during the trial and three in the preceding eight-week period. The periods had different workloads, and the note explicitly does not attribute the difference to the software.”
+
+**Comparison:** “Bolagets anteckning” names the company's internal trial note, not an independent study. The nonspecific “en skillnad” is later specified as median report-to-assignment time. The preceding comparison period and the note's explicit nonattribution to the software are preserved. The draft does not turn the nonattribution into a finding that software had no effect. No finding.
+
+### 4. Introduction: supervisor's experiences
+
+**Draft:** “Här beskriver arbetsledaren erfarenheterna.”
+
+**Source:** “Customer interview with maintenance supervisor Maya Lind, complete usable quotations:” followed by the three supplied quotations, including “We spent more time agreeing on the categories than entering the first reports” and “Having one view of the reports helps us, but I would leave an extra week for preparation.”
+
+**Comparison:** This is an introduction to the actual supervisor's supplied account of the trial. The plural “erfarenheterna” refers to that account, which covers shared shift information, category preparation, use of the overview and the requested extra preparation week. The wording invents no further incident, experience or personal opinion. No finding.
+
+### 5. Introduction: publisher and status
+
+**Draft:** “Kundfallet publiceras av leverantören Svale Systems.”
+
+**Source:** Brief: “The publisher is the supplier, Svale Systems.” Material: “The supplier approved publication of this case as supplier-published material; it is not independent journalism.”
+
+**Comparison:** The publisher and its supplier role are exactly identified. The draft presents the case as supplier-published and does not claim independent verification. No finding.
+
+### 6. Byline
+
+**Draft:** “Av Thomas Barregren”
+
+**Comparison:** The task expressly supplies the provenance of the author name and excludes its absence from the material as a finding. No customer or interview assertion is attributed to this person by the byline. No finding.
+
+### 7. Company and housing stock
+
+**Draft:** “Elm Quay Housing förvaltar 640 lägenheter.”
+
+**Source:** “Elm Quay Housing manages 640 flats.”
+
+**Comparison:** Company, count and management relationship are unchanged. “Lägenheter” renders “flats” in this housing-company context. The draft does not claim ownership, that all flats were in the trial, or that 640 people lived there. No finding.
+
+### 8. Previously separate information
+
+**Draft:** “Tidigare förvarades telefonanmälningar och mejl var för sig.”
+
+**Source:** “Previously telephone reports and emails were stored separately.”
+
+**Comparison:** Information type, previous time frame and separation are preserved. “Förvarades” is the storage statement, without an invented storage medium or claim that the information could never be found. No finding.
+
+### 9. Decision, ownership of team and decision date
+
+**Draft:** “I september 2025 beslöt bolagets eget underhållsteam att pröva en gemensam reparationslogg.”
+
+**Source:** “In September 2025 its own maintenance team decided to trial a shared repair log in two buildings.”
+
+**Comparison:** Date, actual decision, the company's own team and the log are preserved. The sentence does not restate “in two buildings,” but that scope is stated in the introduction and nowhere widened. The team's own decision is not reassigned to Svale. No finding.
+
+### 10. Team's purpose
+
+**Draft:** “Teamet ville att personal på olika skift skulle se samma information.”
+
+**Source:** “The team wanted staff on different shifts to see the same information.”
+
+**Comparison:** This preserves the team's desire and its shift-to-shift purpose, not a measured claim that every staff member actually used the log. No finding.
+
+### 11. Telephone heading
+
+**Draft:** “Teamet håller telefonvägen öppen”
+
+**Source:** “The maintenance team designed its categories and kept telephone reporting open for residents.”
+
+**Comparison:** The heading introduces the immediately following historical trial account, in which residents could continue reporting by telephone. Its present tense functions as a narrative heading within that account; it does not specify a new date or promise a continuing company-wide policy. “Telefonvägen” is telephone reporting, not an asserted telephone opening-hours schedule. The team's agency is preserved. No finding.
+
+### 12. Selection and test
+
+**Draft:** “Teamet valde Svale Systems efter att ha testat om loggen kunde visa status för varje reparation.”
+
+**Source:** “It chose Svale Systems after testing whether the log could show the status of each repair. No comparison with another supplier is available.”
+
+**Comparison:** The team remains the selecting and testing actor. Sequence and the capability that was tested are preserved; “om ... kunde” preserves testing whether the capability existed. This does not say Svale won a supplier comparison, and no comparison is introduced elsewhere. No finding.

+### 13. Residents' continued reporting channel
+
+**Draft:** “De boende kunde fortsätta anmäla reparationer per telefon.”
+
+**Source:** “The maintenance team designed its categories and kept telephone reporting open for residents.”
+
+**Comparison:** The channel's availability is rendered as residents' continuing ability to report by telephone. It does not claim that every resident actually called, that calls were answered immediately or that telephone reporting was the only channel. “Reparationer” is understood as the repair matters being reported, consistently with “telephone reports” and the surrounding repair-log context. No finding.

+
+**Draft:** “Underhållsarbetsledaren Maya Lind beskriver syftet i en mejlintervju:”
+
+**Source:** “Customer interview with maintenance supervisor Maya Lind, complete usable quotations:” “All interviews occurred by email, and no physical scene, emotion or remembered dialogue is provided.” First quotation: “We wanted the evening shift to see what the morning shift had already done. The categories were ours; Svale helped us put them into the log.”
+
+**Comparison:** Lind's name, maintenance supervisory role, email medium and the attribution of the ensuing statement are supported. “Mejlintervju” does not invent a live scene or spoken encounter. The quotation does explain purpose. No finding.

+
+**Draft:** “– Vi ville att kvällsskiftet skulle se vad morgonskiftet redan hade gjort. Kategorierna var våra; Svale hjälpte oss att lägga in dem i loggen.”
+
+**Source:** “We wanted the evening shift to see what the morning shift had already done. The categories were ours; Svale helped us put them into the log.”
+
+**Comparison:** Desire, evening and morning shifts, anterior “already,” the team's ownership of categories, and Svale's supporting role all survive. The desire is not strengthened into a measured successful handover. “Lägga in dem i loggen” renders putting those categories into the log; it does not say Svale designed them. First-person collective voice and the direct contrast between “ours” and Svale helping are preserved. The Swedish is an idiomatic rendering with no concrete obstruction to the same reading. No source-support or translation finding.
+
+### 16. Preparation heading
+
+**Draft:** “Maya Lind återkommer till förberedelserna”
+
+**Source:** “We spent more time agreeing on the categories than entering the first reports. I would set that time aside before the next building starts.” And: “I would choose to do the trial again. Having one view of the reports helps us, but I would leave an extra week for preparation.”
+
+**Comparison:** Both quotations address preparation. “Återkommer” describes this recurrence in her supplied account, not a second interview, a repeat visit or an invented frequency of statements. No finding.

+
+**Draft:** “Svale konfigurerade loggen och utbildade sex medarbetare vid två tillfällen.”
+
+**Source:** “Svale configured the log and trained six staff during two sessions.”
+
+**Comparison:** Supplier actor, configuration, six staff and two training occasions are unchanged. In this context the two sessions are two training occasions; neither sentence says that every staff member attended both, that two calendar days were required or that exactly six staff constituted the whole maintenance team. “Utbildade” supplies no certification or competence outcome beyond the stated training. No finding.
+
+### 18. Category-work attribution
+
+**Draft:** “I mejlintervjun beskriver Maya Lind arbetet med kategorierna:”
+
+**Source:** “All interviews occurred by email” and the second quotation: “We spent more time agreeing on the categories than entering the first reports. I would set that time aside before the next building starts.”
+
+**Comparison:** The interview medium and the category work that the ensuing quotation describes are supported. No finding.

+### 19. Second translated quotation
+
+**Draft:** “– Vi ägnade mer tid åt att enas om kategorierna än åt att lägga in de första anmälningarna. Jag skulle avsätta den tiden innan nästa hus kommer igång.”

+**Source:** “We spent more time agreeing on the categories than entering the first reports. I would set that time aside before the next building starts.”
+
+**Comparison:** The relative time spent, agreement on categories and first-report entry remain the same. No absolute duration is invented. “Den tiden” preserves “that time,” meaning the time needed for agreement on categories. “Jag skulle” retains the personal, conditional recommendation rather than presenting a scheduled action. The next building beginning is the same metonymic formulation as the source's “the next building starts”; in this trial context it concerns beginning at another building, not construction, occupancy or a claim that expansion has already been decided. “Kommer igång” is idiomatic for that beginning in context. The original practical, first-person voice survives. No source-support or translation finding.

+### 20. Measurement heading
+
+**Draft:** “Mätningen lämnar orsaken öppen”
+
+**Source:** “Median time from report to assignment was two working days during the trial and three in the preceding eight-week period. The periods had different workloads, and the note explicitly does not attribute the difference to the software.”
+
+**Comparison:** This is the author's supported description of what the measurement establishes: a difference, with no attributed software cause. It does not declare that the software was ineffective or assert some alternative cause. The singular “Mätningen” is a heading for the stated metric and comparison, not a new count of every observation or measurement operation. No finding.
+
+### 21. Internal note, date, recorded count and period
+
+**Draft:** “Elm Quays interna försöksanteckning från den 4 december 2025 redovisar 31 registrerade reparationsanmälningar under de åtta veckorna.”

+**Source:** “The trial lasted eight weeks. Elm Quay's internal trial note, 4 December 2025, says that 31 repair reports were entered. It excludes emergencies and work ordered before the trial.”
+
+**Comparison:** Company ownership, internal status, trial-note character, date, count and eight-week period are preserved. “Registrerade” names the entered reports in the established log context and is not a claim that the note counted all repair demand. +**Comparison:** In this repair-report setting “Akutärenden” are the emergency cases, and the prior-order cutoff applies to work ordered before the trial. The sentence concerns the note's reported scope, not a claim that the log could not handle emergencies or that none happened. No finding.

+
+**Draft:** “Medianen för tiden från anmälan till tilldelning var två arbetsdagar, jämfört med tre under den föregående åttaveckorsperioden.”

+**Source:** “Median time from report to assignment was two working days during the trial and three in the preceding eight-week period. The periods had different workloads, and the note explicitly does not attribute the difference to the software.”
+
+**Comparison:** Median, endpoints, working-day units, two versus three and the preceding eight-week period are exact. The trial period for the first number is supplied by the immediately preceding sentence and this section's context. Assignment is not changed into completion. “Jämfört med” is a numerical comparison and does not establish cause. The next two sentences retain the different-workload and nonattribution qualifications. No finding.

+
+**Draft:** “Perioderna hade olika arbetsbelastning.”
+
+**Source:** “The periods had different workloads, and the note explicitly does not attribute the difference to the software.”
+
+**Comparison:** Different workloads are preserved without asserting which period's workload was greater, why they differed, or how that difference affected the median. “Arbetsbelastning” is the workload in this maintenance setting. No finding.

+
+**Draft:** “Anteckningen tillskriver uttryckligen inte skillnaden programvaran.”
+
+**Source:** “The periods had different workloads, and the note explicitly does not attribute the difference to the software.”
+
+**Comparison:** The knowledge and assertion belong to the note. The difference refers to the medians just stated. The draft retains “explicitly” and the exact boundary: no attribution, without an assertion that software could not have contributed. No finding.

+**Draft:** “Teamet ska besluta efter att ha kontrollerat hur kategorierna fungerar för större reparationer.”
+
+**Source:** “The trial has not yet expanded; the team will decide after checking how the categories work for larger repairs.”
+
+**Comparison:** The future decision, preceding check, manner of category operation and larger-repair scope are unchanged. “Ska” reflects the source's definite “will”; adding a hedge would weaken the supplied statement. Neither passage says that the check has already succeeded or that the decision will approve expansion. No finding.

+
+**Draft:** “Maya Lind ger sin bedömning av försöket:”
+

+
+**Comparison:** The assessment is attributed to Lind and concerns her experience of the trial. It is not attributed to the note, the author, independent research or every housing company. No finding.

+### 32. Third translated quotation
+
+**Draft:** “– Jag skulle välja att göra försöket igen. Att ha en samlad vy över anmälningarna hjälper oss, men jag skulle avsätta en extra vecka för förberedelser.”
+
+**Source:** “I would choose to do the trial again. Having one view of the reports helps us, but I would leave an extra week for preparation.”
+
+**Comparison:** Lind's conditional choice to repeat the trial is preserved, without becoming a universal supplier recommendation. “En samlad vy” expresses the supplied single view of reports; “hjälper oss” retains her actual, unhedged account of usefulness to the group. The contrastive “men” and the extra preparation week preserve her reservation. “Avsätta” renders making that extra time available for preparation, not a claim that she already spent the week or will definitely do so. The direct, practical and qualified voice survives idiomatically. No source-support or translation finding.
+
+### 33. Optional next-step heading
+
+**Draft:** “Du kan läsa vidare om ett införande”
+
+**Source:** Brief: “The optional next step is the supplied implementation checklist at https://example.invalid/svale/checklist; it is a document to read, not a consultation booking or a product trial.”
+
+**Comparison:** The next step is optional reading about implementation, as supplied. “Kan” offers that option and does not promise implementation success. No finding.
+
+### 34. Document and link destination
+
+**Draft:** “Det finns en [checklista för införande](https://example.invalid/svale/checklist).”
+
+**Source:** Brief: “The optional next step is the supplied implementation checklist at https://example.invalid/svale/checklist; it is a document to read, not a consultation booking or a product trial.”
+
+**Comparison:** The named document type, implementation subject and exact supplied URL are preserved. No invented trial, booking or consulting offer is introduced. The fictional source package authorizes this supplied link; no external verification is needed or permitted. No finding.
+
+### 35. Reading invitation
+
+**Draft:** “Läs den om du vill gå vidare med förberedelserna.”
+
+**Source:** Brief: “The optional next step is the supplied implementation checklist at https://example.invalid/svale/checklist; it is a document to read, not a consultation booking or a product trial.” Preparation quotations: “I would set that time aside before the next building starts.” “I would leave an extra week for preparation.”
+
+**Comparison:** The invitation is the author's optional next-step advocacy, resting on the supplied document and preparation discussion. It makes no factual promise that the checklist resolves all preparation questions or that the reader must proceed. No finding.
